text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Yaeno
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Using the blaze fierce, water still
principle from
the Kongo Yaegaki style
of martial arts, I hope to
produce
excellent racing results, thus repaying

my grandparents for their teachings.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm placing myself under your
capable
tutelage. Osu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
